nome_jp: 魔壊業皇 デストピア
testo:
Blocker
Double Breaker
■ Whenever your opponent summons a creature or casts a spell, your opponent chooses 2 cards from their hand and discards them. If they don't, your opponent chooses one of their elements or a card in their mana zone and puts it into their graveyard.
testo_jp:
Blocker
Double Breaker
■ 相手がクリーチャーを召喚した時または呪文を唱えた時、相手は自身の手札を2枚選んで捨てる。そうしなければ、相手は自身のエレメント1つまたは自身のマナゾーンにあるカード1枚を選び、墓地に置く。
